mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wx_msg_session s
LEFT JOIN wx_user u ON u.appid = s.appid AND u.openid = s.openid
WHERE s.appid = #{appid} AND s.has_real_msg = 1
AND (u.nickname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.remark LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO wx_msg_session (appid, openid, last_msg_time, last_msg_summary, has_real_msg) VALUES (#{appid}, #{openid}, #{msgTime}, #{summary}, 1) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_msg_summary = IF(last_msg_time IS NULL OR #{msgTime} >= last_msg_time, VALUES(last_msg_summary), last_msg_summary), last_msg_time = IF(last_msg_time IS NULL OR #{msgTime} >= last_msg_time, VALUES(last_msg_time), last_msg_time), has_real_msg = 1

INSERT INTO wx_msg_session (appid, openid, last_in_time) VALUES (#{appid}, #{openid}, #{inTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_in_time = IF(last_in_time IS NULL OR #{inTime} > last_in_time, VALUES(last_in_time), last_in_time)
